ops.title: cc-skills: binrun-shim grows a per-plugin platforms arg
ops.description: Found during the v0.21 flag day (2026-08-03): cc-review and cc-patch dropped their linux release legs, but plugin/scripts/install-binary.sh is a cc-guides-generated fleet-wide fragment (cc-skills:binrun-shim) with no local content slot, so a per-tool platform guard cannot land in the consumer repos. Today a linux user gets binrun's generic "no artifact for this platform" (accurate, pre-download, via artifact.ErrUnsupportedPlatform) rather than "<tool> is macOS-only". The fix belongs in cc-skills: teach the binrun-shim fragment an optional platforms arg that guards before exec'ing binrun. Two customers exist already (cc-review, cc-patch); more will follow as the fleet goes macOS-only. Separate lane from the flag day; nothing blocks on it.

ops.text: cc-skills' binrun-shim fragment accepts a platforms arg (e.g. ["darwin"]) and the rendered install-binary.sh fails fast on unsupported platforms with a message naming the tool and its supported set
cc-review and cc-patch adopt it and their rendered install scripts carry the guard after a guides re-render
